theme.en: National AI Stacks Pull Supply Chains Inward
theme.zh: 国家级AI体系牵引供应链内聚

dek.en: Samsung’s foundry pact, CXMT’s market debut, and new inference and semiconductor initiatives in South Korea and Bangladesh show capital and procurement being organized around more self-contained technology stacks. The contest now extends from accelerators into memory, materials, and manufacturing.
dek.zh: Samsung的晶圆代工协议、CXMT上市，以及韩国和孟加拉国的新推理与半导体计划，都显示资本与采购正围绕更自主的技术体系重新组织。竞争已从加速器延伸至存储、材料和制造环节。

title.en: AI90 Tiers HBM, DDR, and SSD Capacity Across Eight RTX 5090 GPUs

summary.en: AI90 combines HBM, DDR, and SSD storage to extend the usable memory capacity of a system built around eight RTX 5090 GPUs, according to TechRadar. The tiered design targets a recurring inference constraint: model and KV-cache footprints can exceed local GPU memory even when sufficient compute is available.
summary.zh: 据TechRadar报道，AI90把HBM、DDR和SSD组成分层存储，为配备八张RTX 5090 GPU的系统扩展可用内存容量。该设计瞄准推理中的常见约束：即便算力充足，模型与KV-cache的占用仍可能超过GPU本地显存。

title.en: Samsung Wins $200 Billion Broadcom AI-Chip Partnership
title.zh: Samsung赢得Broadcom价值$2000亿的AI芯片合作

summary.en: Samsung Electronics secured a $200 billion AI-chip partnership with Broadcom, giving its foundry business a major new anchor customer, Reuters reports. The scale of the agreement could strengthen Samsung’s challenge to TSMC if it converts into sustained advanced-node and packaging volume rather than remaining a broad spending commitment.
summary.zh: 据Reuters报道，Samsung Electronics与Broadcom达成价值$2000亿的AI芯片合作，为其晶圆代工业务带来一个重要的锚定客户。若这项协议最终转化为持续的先进制程与封装订单，而不只是宽泛的支出承诺，其规模可能增强Samsung对TSMC的竞争力。

title.en: Major Motherboard Vendors Validate CXMT DDR5
title.zh: 主要主板厂商完成CXMT DDR5验证

summary.en: Major motherboard makers have validated CXMT DDR5 modules, although the products remain difficult for most US system builders to purchase, Tech Times reports. Broad platform validation is an important commercialization step for the Chinese DRAM supplier, but restricted channel availability still limits its reach outside its home market.
summary.zh: 据Tech Times报道，主要主板厂商已完成对CXMT DDR5模组的验证，但多数美国整机组装商仍难以采购这些产品。广泛的平台验证是这家中国DRAM供应商走向商业化的重要一步，不过受限的渠道覆盖仍压缩了其海外市场空间。

title.en: Apple Weighs CXMT and YMTC Supply as Memory Costs Rise
title.zh: 存储成本上升之际，Apple考虑引入CXMT与YMTC

summary.en: Apple is considering a memory-supply agreement with CXMT and YMTC as component costs rise, according to BigGo Finance. Any procurement shift would carry unusual policy risk because both suppliers face US security restrictions, turning a cost decision into a test of how far global electronics buyers can diversify toward Chinese memory.
summary.zh: 据BigGo Finance报道，随着元器件成本上升，Apple正考虑与CXMT和YMTC达成存储供应协议。由于两家供应商均面临美国安全限制，任何采购调整都将承担非同寻常的政策风险，也会检验全球电子产品厂商能在多大程度上转向中国存储供应。

title.en: KKR Plans Gradual Exit as LCY Expands Chip Materials
title.zh: LCY加速扩张半导体材料业务，KKR计划逐步退出

summary.en: KKR is planning a gradual exit from LCY Group while the company accelerates expansion of its semiconductor-materials business, DigiTimes reports. The sequencing matters because LCY must fund and execute capacity growth while a major financial shareholder reduces its exposure, potentially reshaping its capital structure during an investment cycle.
summary.zh: 据DigiTimes报道，LCY Group正在加速扩张半导体材料业务，与此同时KKR计划逐步退出持股。两项动作同步发生值得关注：LCY需要在大股东降低敞口之际为产能扩张筹资并推进建设，其资本结构可能在投资周期中发生变化。

title.en: CXMT Debut Tests China’s State-Funded Chip Strategy
title.zh: CXMT上市检验中国国家资本支持的芯片战略

summary.en: CXMT’s market debut puts China’s state-funded route to semiconductor scale under public-market scrutiny, according to a Reuters analysis syndicated by AOL. The listing can supply capital for DRAM expansion, but investors will also have to price the equipment constraints and technology-access risks created by US export controls.
summary.zh: 据AOL转载的Reuters分析，CXMT登陆资本市场，使中国依靠国家资本推动半导体规模化的路径开始接受公开市场检验。上市可为DRAM扩张补充资本，但投资者也必须为美国出口管制造成的设备约束与技术获取风险定价。

title.en: Bangladesh’s $1 Billion Chip Ambition Enters the Execution Phase
title.zh: 孟加拉国$10亿半导体计划进入执行阶段

summary.en: Bangladesh’s $1 billion semiconductor ambition is moving from policy framing into an execution phase, The Business Standard reports. Delivering it will depend on converting the headline target into workforce, infrastructure, and credible private investment, illustrating the higher bar facing new entrants to the global chip supply chain.
summary.zh: 据The Business Standard报道，孟加拉国规模达$10亿的半导体计划正从政策构想进入执行阶段。能否落地取决于能否把宏观目标转化为人才、基础设施和可信的私人投资，也凸显新参与者进入全球芯片供应链所面临的更高门槛。

title.en: Rebellions Teams With Arm and SKT on Korean AI Inference

summary.en: Rebellions is working with Arm and SK Telecom on South Korea’s shift toward domestically anchored AI inference, ChosunBiz reports. The combination gives the accelerator challenger an established CPU ecosystem and a telecom deployment channel, two ingredients that matter more than peak benchmark claims when competing for production workloads.
summary.zh: 据ChosunBiz报道，Rebellions正与Arm和SK Telecom合作，推动韩国AI推理向本土主导的体系转移。这一组合为这家加速器新势力带来成熟的CPU生态和电信部署渠道；在争取生产级负载时，这两项条件比单纯的峰值基准成绩更关键。
